description: This file defines the MoveService class which manages move submissions within the tic-tac-toe backend, including user validation, move application, and error handling.

classes.name: MoveService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling move submissions in the game, including user validation and applying moves to the game state.

methods.name: constructor(gamesRepo)
methods.description: Initializes the MoveService with a reference to the games repository.

methods.name: submitMove({ userId, gameId, row, col })
methods.description: Handles the submission of a move, including validation of the game existence and user permissions, and applying the move through the repository.

ctags.name: submitMove
